name: studio-management-system
description: Studio management system - Web, iOS, Android, Mac, Windows

scripts.web: npm run build:prod && echo 'Web build complete: dist/studio-management-system/browser'
scripts.android: npm run build:prod && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.android:build: npm run build:prod && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:prod: npm run build:prod && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.ios: npm run build:prod && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.ios:build: npm run build:prod && npx cap sync ios && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -archivePath App.xcarchive archive
scripts.ios:sim: npm run build:prod && npx cap sync ios && npx cap run ios
scripts.all: npm run build:prod && npx cap sync
